title: Real Estate Brokerage
description: Leads, listings, transactions and closing milestones for a small brokerage.

spec.useCase: Bertrand Quimby coordinates transactions at a small brokerage and uses this to see today's lead follow-ups, which listings are active, and which closing milestones are due this week on every deal under contract.

text.text: Your brokerage in one place. Follow up with new Leads today, keep each Listing current, and run every Transaction from accepted offer to closing with dated Milestones. Operational tracking only.
Speed and consistency win clients. Set a follow-up date on every lead.
Call within the hour; text if no answer.
Log what they want, their timeline and whether they have talked to a lender.
Set Follow up by to a specific day.
Contact every Nurturing lead at least every two weeks.
After three months of silence, move to Lost with a note.
Photos, floor plan and description approved by the seller
Social posts and email to the lead list
Weekly update call with the seller
Add milestones the day an offer is accepted so nothing is missed.
Press Start transaction on the listing.
Add milestones from the contract dates: inspection, appraisal, loan commitment, walkthrough, closing.
Introduce the client to title and the lender.
Review Open milestones for every deal.
Mark the transaction Closed, the listing Sold and the lead Closed.
Client added to the annual anniversary list
